source: DDXPlus v2 English test split (CC-BY 4.0): the frozen pool of 3,875 adult, deduplicated rows (data/conversion/pools/ddxplus/manifest.json). case_id = the pool's id.
notes: Patient facts are the recorded positives (and explicit negatives of a present symptom's attributes); every other catalogue item resolves through the catalogue (default 'No' with absent_text, answered_by, open-world items, or not applicable when its parent is absent or, for items with `applies_to`, for the other sex).
